notes: Company background: B2B SaaS (product analytics for mobile apps). Heavy chat-based support + doc search in-app.
Current provider: GlyphAI (multi-region managed). Willowbend wants to reduce per-token cost and gain routing controls.
Primary drivers: predictable latency, lower tail cost, operational visibility. Interested in switching from hosted -> dedicated once parity proven.
POC scope (agreed): 1) Hosted API pilot as drop-in (compat shim) 2) Run prompt parity suite + evals 3) Measure latency P95 and cost per 1M tokens 4) Run small Dedicated sizing exercise.
Technical constraints: must support existing function-calling hooks + conversation state preserved across tokenization differences. SDKs used: Node (backend), Python for eval harness.
Latency/throughput targets: 95th <= 350ms for short chat messages (<=256 tokens); burst to 500 rps for embeddings batch jobs off-hours.
Cost sensitivity: target 30-40% token cost reduction vs GlyphAI or clear offset via batching and KV caching.
Quote from PM: "We can't accept any degradation in intent matching — support NPS will drop fast."

Compatibility notes: implemented compat shim that maps GlyphAI params (model, temperature, max_tokens, functions) to Redwood hosted params; edge cases: token counting differences affect truncation strategy.
Regression findings: three prompt families show higher hallucination; likely due to sampling defaults and model variant differences — SE working on temperature and system prompt normalization.
Legal/Security: Willowbend requires data residency for EU customers; asked about Dedicated VPC placement for EU region and KMS integration.
POC milestones: baseline scoring (complete), prompt parity iter 1 (in progress), security questionnaire (2 of 5 sections pending), Dedicated pricing call scheduled.
Next tacticals: deliver prompt-parity report (w/ examples), propose quantized Dedicated instance types and pricing, schedule 1-week canary plan with rollback criteria.
Short-term asks from Willowbend: clear mapping doc of API differences, tokenization notes, list of recommended quantization profiles for their workload.
Sales notes: strong buy signal if regressions <=1% and Dedicated TCO within forecast range. Procurement expected to engage in May if POC OK.
